integrity: Mathematical argument supplied in RESULT.md; exact-rational witness and finite reproducibility checks supplied in verify.py. Computation corroborates, but does not prove, the theorem for all real residues. No independent expert validation or priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only six parties in three distinct lower-quota pairs, strictly different residues inside every pair, exactly three surplus seats, and quota-preserving ex-ante proportional lotteries. This theorem does not determine the exact minimum envy when no zero-envy allocation exists. Tied within-pair residues are outside the literal no-envy classification.
title: Three paired apportionment strata: exact envy-free feasibility and sharp lottery support
